parent_objective: design a no-training feasibility audit for replay-constrained target construction before more actor updates
blocked_by: controlled-fusion local objectives cannot produce exact/preflight overlap
invalidates: additional local controlled-fusion coefficient retunes before target feasibility

public_gates: M953 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M953 must design a feasibility check for targets satisfying normal retention, low-tail lift, and M267 proof retention
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run another controlled-fusion local retune
do not open encoders or GRU

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_target_feasibility: existence of replay-constrained targets before more actor updates
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a no-training target feasibility audit after controlled-fusion synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, no replay promotion, no private holdout, no PPO
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot define target feasibility criteria
stop if the design relies on hidden actor inputs
stop if it proposes training before target feasibility
fallback_plan: if feasible targets exist, route to target export implementation
if no feasible targets exist, route to wider-surface synthesis or objective-threshold audit
if tooling is missing, route to infrastructure implementation first
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M952 pivots from controlled-fusion local objective retuning to target feasibility

hypothesis: Before widening the actor or running more training, the project should prove that replay-constrained targets exist inside the current trust region.
success_criteria: normal-retention, low-tail lift, and M267 proof constraints are all included
training, PPO, and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design skips one of the three feasibility constraints

commands.name: write_design
commands.command: Write the replay-constrained target feasibility design and route M954.

decision_rule: M953 may only design the target feasibility audit. It must not train, run PPO, or promote.
